H1.why: The summary states the trial diet 'was not fed exclusively' and that it 'is not a test of the diet alone', which carry the bottom line of the trial_reading lines and the confounder scope.

H2.why: Counts are given without any change, improvement or causal wording. The trial sentence explicitly disclaims attribution to the diet alone.

H3.why: The summary does not mention refusals or intake, so nothing is softened or read as preference.

H4.why: Nothing is presented as normal, stable or clear because of absent entries.

H5.why: The vomiting numbers carry their windows and denominators ('last 7 days', 'on 12 of 45 logged days'). Nothing misleading is stripped.

H6.why: Every claim in the summary traces to the band or record lines: the counts, the dates, the trial foods and the not-exclusive statement.

H7.why: Sentence 1 states band item 1 (vomiting burden, 6 entries in 7 days, 3 days in a row) with the same numbers and calls it a live flag. No sentence makes a band item calmer, smaller or older.
